::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 1 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P. 312
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
We will give you the [£200](organizations/other_160.qmd) for the copyright of the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd). It is a rather full sum but the book is of a kind we like to possess. Some day we will get a series of actual Cameos engraved for it. But in the mean time we contract [*illegible*] with [one for the title page](organizations/other_167.qmd) & one for the cover. [I](people/person_939.qmd)think you will certainly like the look of the book.

We send the '[Pupils](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd)' & '[Golden deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd)' to [Mrs Montgomery Moore](people/person_1042.qmd) by today’s post.

With kind regards
Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan
